summary: Vizhi AI backend fully verified. Ollama connectivity, llama3.2:1b model, Planner Agent (7/7 correct routing including all critical: OCR, Navigation, Emergency), Scene Description (returns objects with bbox+distance_label AND non-empty description referencing detected objects), Object Detection (bbox with x1/y1/x2/y2/image_width/image_height, distance, distance_label, area_ratio), Stream analyze, and all regression endpoints (OCR, TTS, TTS voices, Emergency trigger/cancel, Navigation, Assistant, /health) all pass. 16/16 pytest tests green in 43s. First planner call after warmup returns in <7s (well under 30s frontend threshold).
critical_code_review_comments: planner_router.py uses sync `def` for the endpoint but calls an LLM (blocking) — under load this will block the FastAPI event loop. Consider `async def` + run_in_executor or making decide_agent async.
scene_router.py and detection_router.py similarly do heavy CPU work (YOLO, Ollama) inside async endpoints without awaiting — consider offloading to a threadpool.
No auth on any endpoint (acceptable for MVP but should be flagged for production).
TTS endpoint returns raw FileResponse; audio files under audio_outputs/ appear to be unbounded — add cleanup/TTL.
seed_data_creation: Uses /tmp/test_scene.jpg (bus image from ultralytics) — auto-downloaded by fixture if missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_vizhi_backend.py is the canonical regression suite. Ollama runs via supervisor. Planner first call after cold-start can take ~30s; the fixture uses 90s timeout for the first query and 60s subsequently. All planner queries routed correctly (7/7) with llama3.2:1b at temperature=0.
